title: Everything Refined II
description: Take the game to the next level with stunning visuals, new gameplay mechanics, and a plethora of structures and biomes to explore!
body:
![The Everything: Refined II banner, showcasing the horizon with a distant house](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ae3cb4ad46baad4d8a362ee5d6f5ba00189148a.jpeg)

A complete overhaul of [Everything: Refined](https://modrinth.com/modpack/everything-refined), optimized and updated to 1.21.11.

A modpack built to be easy to understand for new players, and bring significant depth to experienced adventurers.

> Take the game to the next level with stunning visuals, new gameplay mechanics, and a plethora of structures and biomes to explore!

## Graphics: Refined

![A screenshot showcasing the horizon with extended view distance thanks to the Voxy mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/156b6b58323395acfcc8fd46c9e0734362c227a4.jpeg)

### Extended Line of Sight

- Content Included: | Voxy | Voxy WorldGen | ...

### Improved Shaders and Textures

- Content Included: | BSL | Spring Shaders | JICKLUS | Fresh Animations | Rainbow's Foliage | ...

### Smooth UI Animations

- Content Included: | Smooth Swapping | Smooth Scrolling | ...

## Exploration: Refined

![A zoomed-in isometric screenshot of a giant castle and a balloon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f11aa39db99f4663182f8cdd8359aa977f8525c6.jpeg)

- Content Included: | Terralith | Serene Seasons | Incendium | Stellarity | ...

### Structures

- Content Included: | Immersive Structures | Epic Structures | Repurposed Structures | Structory | ...

## Combat: Refined

![Three pillagers. The focused one has an indicator above its head indicating his superior level and special attributes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a2c393118535feacd8a30f7a6f0c21eccf543588.jpeg)

- Content Included: | Better Combat | Better Vanilla Mobs | Too Many Bows | Combat Roll | ...

- Content Included: | AmbientSounds | Sounds Physics Remastered | Cool Rain | Sounds | ...
